text: Picture, the photo is what your application for pictures in your phone will generate. Okay, and a photo is made of pixels, right? They are data, they can be encoded into bits. Okay, so now we have these bits that correspond to a photo. These bits are grouped into packets. So we have the packets generated by the application. Okay, now each of these packets need to be uploaded, right? Because you want to upload your picture. So these packets need to be transferred to the access point, and then from the access point to the internet. Okay, so then the picture will be stored, for example, in a repository. So the goal is to transfer the application packets to the access point and then to the internet. What Wi-Fi will do is to transfer these packets from your Wi-Fi card in your phone to the access point. That's what Wi-Fi does. Okay, so Wi-Fi acts.
